children: -- poLight ASA (OSE: PLT) today announced that the company has received a follow-on purchase order from an industry-leading photonics manufacturer for stacked TLens®, used in their recognized Miniature Two-Photon (Mini2P) Imaging System. The purchase order is valued at NOK 3.0 million, and will be delivered throughout 2027.

Mini2P is an open-source brain explorer for fast high-resolution calcium imaging in freely moving mice developed by Kavli Institute for Systems Neuroscience at Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU). TLens® tunable optics enables fast and stable imaging of multiple interleaved planes, as well as 3D functional imaging, providing critical insights that will advance neurological research.
“We are honored to provide a key component of Mini2P devices and pleased that our customers continue to see market demand and success with their system,” said Dr. Øyvind Isaksen, CEO of poLight ASA.
Dr Øyvind Isaksen, CEO, poLight ASA: +47 90 87 63 98

offers a patented, proprietary tunable optics technology which replicates “the human eye” experience in autofocus cameras used in devices such as AR/MR glasses, smartphones, barcode scanners, machine vision systems and various medical equipment. poLight’s first product TLens® enables better system performance and new user experiences due to benefits such as extremely fast focus, small footprint, no magnetic interference, low power consumption and constant field of view. poLight is based in Tønsberg, Norway, with employees in Finland, France, UK, US, China, Taiwan and the Philippines. title: poLight ASA Receives Follow-on Purchase Order for TLens® in Leading Mini2P Imaging System
